notes: Starting cards as posted under 'starting': The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone ('hyperdrive objective'), Credits Will Do Fine, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard ('watto's JY'), Tatooine: City Outskirts ('tatoutskirts'), Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena ('tatpodrace arena'), Boonta Eve Podrace and Anakin's Podracer; these count toward the 60. The author lists no starting Effect (Brisky Morning Munchen or Another Pathetic Lifeform depending on the opponent).
The title says 'type2' and the description says it is built for the current 'ep1 format' (Episode I-only environment). The Coruscant-set printings are used for Tatooine, Alter, Sense and Control.

Posted 'ai' dested the Alternate Image printings: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (AI), Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI), Senator Palpatine (AI) and Qui-Gon Jinn (AI). 'queen amidala ruler of nab' and 'quigon's light' have no 'ai' and dested the regular printings (Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber, Tatooine).
Posted 'a vergence in the force x2+' is counted as 2. Header lines ('epic events', 'locations', 'charectars', 'strategy' etc.) and strategy paragraphs mis-parsed as cards were removed.
